testmdHelp:
Usage: kane-cli testmd [options] [command]

Manage test.md files (run, list, status, delete, export, sync)

Options:
  -h, --help               display help for command

Commands:
  delete [options] <path>  Remove output-<stem>/ and the *_test.md source file
                           (TMS untouched)
  export [options] <path>  Generate standalone test code (Playwright)
  list [options]           List *_test.md files in the working directory
                           (recursive)
  run [options] <path>     Run a test from a *_test.md file
  status <path>            Print local meta.json for a *_test.md (no live TMS
                           check in v1)
  sync [options] <path>    Zip the testmd + imports + replay outputs and push
                           {commit_id}-testmd.zip to cloud
